scope: Offline source integrity, captured metadata completeness, routine/table reciprocity, comment coordinates, static Markdown link checks, protected connection-value scan and final artifact inventory. No database queries, execution or browser rendering.

resolved_review_findings.finding: Historical table-usage bindings were stale against 21 reviewed batch files
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Fresh separate programming-layout-table-usage.json binds current batch hashes; historical report preserved.

resolved_review_findings.finding: Batch-only roles omitted seven existing base table narratives
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Verified base roles included; 517 captured tables retain reviewed roles.

resolved_review_findings.finding: Routine contract source snippets formed accidental Markdown links
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Literal source text escapes Markdown syntax; final static links pass and exact SQL/JSON source bytes are unchanged.

resolved_review_findings.finding: Authored routine Markdown retained excerpt trailing whitespace
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Final Markdown whitespace normalization verified against frozen artifact manifest; original SQL and structured JSON were not normalized.

limits: The September 29 retained replica capture is not a fresh database inspection.
Complete layouts preserve captured fields; they are not original CREATE TABLE batches or complete replayable DDL.
Static relationships and comments do not establish execution, physical scans, table lifecycle or vendor-base ownership.
The protected-value scan compares supplied connection password/user/server values without persisting or printing them; it is not a general discovery scan for every possible historical secret.
Markdown verification is static link/syntax checking, not a browser visual review.
